title: PERSONAWEAVER: Controllable Diversity Beyond Conventional Archetypes in Procedural Character Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generated characters' level of agreement with normative moral statements from the Social Chemistry dataset to measure homogenization toward default positive moral judgments.

Classifying characters' responses to open-ended conversational questions from the ConvAI2 dataset into refusal, deflection, or compliance to measure over-reliance on helpful, assistant-like reactions.

Scoring the conventionality of generated characters' world-attribute combinations (e.g., occupations, demographics, and residence) using both LLM-based scoring and human annotators to identify reliance on predictable or stereotypical archetypes.
